description: Dataset for integrity attacks on time synchronized synchrophasor data is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Taylah Griffiths et al. Phasor measurement units, also known as synchrophasors, are used within smart grids to determine the stability of the grid. These devices send synchrophasor data to phasor data concentrators that collate and analyse the data. Recently, synchrophasor communication data has become beneficial for the research community. However, datasets covering cyberattacks on synchrophasor data are not public. Coverage: not stated; published in 2026. Formats: ZIP, CSV. The data are held in Edith Cowan University and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 251MB. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
